target.title: fix(discord): send fresh final messages after previews
target.body:
## Summary

- stop Discord partial-stream finals from editing the preview message in place
- declare Discord `finalEdit` support as disabled while keeping normal fallback/preview cleanup support
- update Discord monitor tests to expect fresh final delivery and draft cleanup

## Why

Fixes regression reported in #99662. When a user navigates away during a long Discord turn, finalizing by editing the existing preview/progress message does not reliably trigger Discord's unread/channel highlight. Sending the completed final answer as a new message restores the normal Discord completion cue.

## Test plan

- `pnpm test:extension discord -- extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.process.test.ts extensions/discord/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts`
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test`
